description: Hierarchical discrete lattice assembly at macroscale: CF-nylon voxels grouped into tens-of-centimetre blocks placed by mobile robots into metre-scale structures. Measured: average lattice density 81.85 kg/m3; 2x2x2 block held 3,445 N (about 2,220x its own weight); 3x3x3 held 8,712 N; the assembled lattice achieves stretch-dominated modulus-density scaling. The most recent measured point that discretely assembled, hierarchically handled lattices keep efficient scaling. 12 pages.
publisher: ACM Symposium on Computational Fabrication (SCF '25), Cambridge, MA; author copy hosted at cba.mit.edu
